# 3ngram v1.5.0

Minor: session continuity lands (issue #166) — typed agent sessions with
write-time provenance, a session-lifecycle REST surface for hooks, and two
default-off triage mechanisms (the worker-side closer and the Stop-nudge
handshake). Nothing triages a session until the flags are turned on.

## Changes

- **`agent_sessions` + write-time provenance.** New table keyed by the natural
  key `(agent, sessionId)`; native `remember`/`revise`/`resolve`/archive accept
  an optional `sessionRunId` and stamp it on audit events. Import rejects the
  reserved key. Erasure redacts session rows in place; the GDPR export includes
  them. Migration `0032`.

- **Session-lifecycle REST surface for hooks.** `POST
  /api/v1/agent-sessions/open`, `/close`, `/heartbeat`, the typed provenance
  read `GET /api/v1/agent-sessions/{sessionRunId}/events`, and `GET
  /api/v1/prompts/debrief` — one renderer shared with the MCP `debrief` prompt,
  now inlining the run's briefed commitments so the model can tell which id to
  resolve.

- **Session closer, default-off** (`SESSION_CLOSER_ENABLED`, a kill switch, not
  just a first-boot default). A lease-expiry sweep closes crashed sessions and
  a resolve-only worker job makes one metered LLM pass over the run's briefed
  commitments — it can `resolve`, never `remember`/`revise`/`archive`.
  Migration `0033`. The worker gains a Dockerfile and a service in both compose
  files.

- **Stop-nudge triage handshake, default-off** (`THREENGRAM_STOP_NUDGE` on the
  hook). `POST /api/v1/agent-sessions/triage/begin` and `/triage/complete`; the
  server decides the debounce, the hook injects only when armed. `3ngram-hook
  stop` ships the client half with Claude Code as the one registered
  validation harness.

- **Supply chain:** the server image build no longer sets
  `npm_config_ignore_scripts`, restoring the `strictDepBuilds` tripwire during
  `docker build` (the worker image got the same fix in #181). nanoid bumped to
  3.3.18 (Dependabot alert #16, dev-only chain).

## Upgrade notes

Run `pnpm db:migrate` — this release adds migrations `0032` and `0033` (one new
table, `agent_sessions`; the table count moves to 27). No breaking API change:
every new surface is additive, `sessionRunId` is optional everywhere it is
accepted, and both triage mechanisms are off until you set their flags. The
SDK's `remember()` now uses the facts-capable V2 argument/output types.
